title: Fantastic pitcher!
text: Fantastic pitcher!. I absolutely love this pitcher! I now want a larger one.  I use it for water with slices of lemon and lime to flavor the water.  The design is perfect and very easy to hold onto. Love it!

product_metadata.title: Hiware 35 Oz Glass Carafe with Stainless Steel Silicone Flip-top Lid - Glass Water Pitcher Fridge Ice Tea Maker
features: REAL BOROSILICATE GLASS: This carafe is made of premium borosilicate glass and is capable of temperatures from 0 to 300℉ meaning you can pour boiling water from tea kettle directly into the carafe to steep tea and coffee with no worries. Also, you can put it in the fridge for storing and cold brewing. It is totally safe and healthy for no lead, no BPA, no plastic and dishwasher safe.

PERFECT SIZE IN FRIDGE: The carafe is 10" in the whole height - the most suitable height for storing in refrigerator, the bottom width is 3.4", not too big but enough for keeping standing steadily, the mouth width is 3.3" and has a narrow neck for easy gripping by hand when pouring and carrying.

MAGIC LID: The movable lid is made of stainless steel with silicone, no plastic in it. The top part is a floating cover which allows the cap to automatically open with force of the water pour, no need to hold the cap or anything while pouring and it has no dribbles. The silicone filter helps to keep the chunks of ice cubes, herbs, fruit fragments inside and the silicone gasket helps to seal.

FOR ALL BEVERAGES: Great for decanting and storing all beverages like iced tea, sangria, fruit infused water, detox water, plain water, lemonade, cold brew coffee, tea, milk, hot cocoa, juice, soda, wine, loose leaf and sun tea. You can also use it to chill boiling water or cold brew in fridge.

STYLISH BUT FUNCTIONAL: The carafe is designed classy and smooth that looks very modern and elegant on multiple daily uses or your themed party, festival drinks, tea parties, banquets and so on. The professional features makes it very convenient and sanitary and it also a good choice as a gift for housewarming and birthday.
